web_search.description: Fetch web results from the Kagi Search API. Each query can include Kagi search options like lens, region, sorting, and date filters. Results from all queries are numbered continuously.

queries.description: One or more Kagi search requests with optional per-query filters and sort settings.

q.description: Search query string, including Kagi query syntax like quotes, OR, site:, and -term.

region.description: Optional region code, or false to explicitly disable region filtering.

from_date.description: Optional lower date bound in YYYY-MM-DD format.

to_date.description: Optional upper date bound in YYYY-MM-DD format.

verbatim.description: Whether to use verbatim search matching.

summarizer.description: Summarize content from a URL using the Kagi Summarizer API. The summarizer can summarize webpages, videos, audio, and other supported documents.

url.description: A URL to a document to summarize.

engine.description: Summarization engine. Use cecil for fast friendly summaries, agnes for formal technical summaries, or muriel for highest quality summaries.

summary_type.description: Type of summary to produce. Use summary for prose or takeaway for bullet points.

target_language.description: Desired output language using language codes such as EN.
